summary: Verified and corrected the follower-rank HiCache backup completion bug identified in the source issue discussion. When replicated MLA/DeepSeek-V4 pools are intentionally written only by TP0 and a follower has no rank-sharded sidecars, HybridCacheController treated the empty local write set as failure and reported zero completed tokens. The correction treats that empty set as vacuous success while retaining explicit result validation for present sidecars.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression: the no-rank-local-sidecar follower path reported completed_tokens=0 instead of 128; the successful and failed sidecar boundary cases already passed. Raw output: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-8ebbaa484fd3/evidence/regression-before.txt

Passing-after regression and independent boundaries: empty local transfer set succeeds, all-success sidecar results succeed, and a partial sidecar failure still reports zero completed tokens (3 passed). Raw output: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-8ebbaa484fd3/evidence/regression-after.txt
Adjacent HiCache pool assembly and Mooncake grouping behavior (17 passed). Raw output: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-8ebbaa484fd3/evidence/adjacent-tests.txt
Python syntax compilation for the modified source and regression test. Exit record: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-8ebbaa484fd3/evidence/compileall.exit

gpu_execution.evidence: The isolated defect is host-side backup accounting and requires no GPU execution. The assigned machine has one AMD gfx950 with ROCm 7.2, while the report requires 8 NVIDIA H20 GPUs, CUDA 13, TP=8, DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 weights, DSPARK, and a large hierarchical-cache workload; those prerequisites were unavailable. No unrelated GPU smoke is presented as issue validation.

remaining_limitations: No full-model reproduction or verification was possible without the reported DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 weights and 8xH20 CUDA topology.

The regression verifies the exact follower-rank completion-accounting defect and its sidecar boundaries, but does not directly measure TAIL_K_SWA canaries, logits, NaN sampling, semantic accuracy, or multi-rank Mooncake behavior.
The source issue remains open and its reporters had not yet posted a fresh-namespace deployment retest confirming that this accounting fix eliminates the production canary violation.
